guideline: 5.1.2 Legal: Privacy - Data Use and Sharing
rejectionSummary: Privacy labels declare Device ID, Precise Location and Advertising Data tracking, but build 6 did not request App Tracking Transparency permission.
confirmedRootCauses: NativeModules.ATTModule was referenced but absent from the iOS project
AdMob plugin used the unsupported userTrackingPermission option, leaving NSUserTrackingUsageDescription absent
